title: Terms and Conditions
intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Sacred Pair when you use sacredpair.com and our apps. Please read them. By creating an account you agree to them. Placeholders in [square brackets] are filled in before launch.

sections.heading: Who can use Sacred Pair
paragraphs: You can use Sacred Pair if you:
items: live in the United States (we'll grow to other countries later),
haven't been removed from Sacred Pair before, and
are not required to register as a sex offender anywhere.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: Keep your sign-in details safe and give us accurate information. You may have one account. You must verify your identity with a government ID before using Sacred Pair; this confirms who you are and your age.

sections.heading: How Sacred Pair works
paragraphs: Each week you can see up to four introductions. If you and someone else choose each other, you're connected and can chat and start a Together journey. Introductions depend on both people's preferences, so we can't promise a particular number of introductions or connections.

sections.heading: Community guidelines
paragraphs: Sacred Pair is for people looking for a serious relationship. Treat everyone with respect. You must not:
items: harass, threaten, bully or intimidate anyone,
post sexual or graphic content, or send it in messages,
use hate speech or attack people for who they are,
ask anyone for money, gifts, investments or financial details,
pretend to be someone else or misrepresent yourself,
use Sacred Pair for business, advertising or recruiting,
share someone else's private information without permission,
do anything illegal, or encourage anyone else to.

sections.heading: Your content
paragraphs: You own what you post. You give Sacred Pair permission to store, display and process it to run the service, for example to show your profile to the people you're introduced to. This permission ends when you delete the content or your account, except where we must keep records (see our Privacy Policy). Only post content you have the right to share.

sections.heading: Safety
paragraphs: We verify every member's identity and age, and we review reports. We don't run criminal background checks, and verification doesn't tell you what someone is like. You're responsible for your own interactions. Read our dating tips, meet in public, and report anyone who makes you uncomfortable.

sections.heading: Reports and enforcement
paragraphs: Anyone can report a member they've met. We may review reported conversations, remove content, end connections, or suspend or remove accounts that break these terms. If we suspend your account, you can ask us to look again by emailing support@sacredpair.com.

sections.heading: Premium
paragraphs: Premium shows more of other members' profiles and lets you filter introductions. When Premium opens, the price, billing period and renewal terms will be shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel. You can cancel at any time in Settings, or in the App Store or Google Play if you subscribed there; Premium then continues until the end of the period you paid for. Refunds follow the law and, for app purchases, Apple's or Google's rules.

sections.heading: Together journeys and tips
paragraphs: Together journeys and our dating tips are for encouragement and learning. They are not professional counseling, therapy, or legal or financial advice.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information.

sections.heading: Disclaimers
paragraphs: Sacred Pair is provided “as is”. To the extent the law allows, we make no promises that it will always be available or error-free, or that you'll find a partner.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent the law allows, Sacred Pair isn't liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for the conduct of any member on or off Sacred Pair. Our total liability to you is limited to the greater of the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim or US$100. Some places don't allow these limits, so they may not apply to you.

sections.heading: Ending your account
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time in Settings. We may suspend or end accounts that break these terms or put others at risk.

sections.heading: Disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of [state], without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. [How disputes are resolved, for example in the courts of a named county or through arbitration, is decided with our lawyer before launch.]

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: If we make important changes, we'll tell you by email or in the app before they take effect. If you keep using Sacred Pair after that, the new terms apply.

sections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: Email support@sacredpair.com or write to [company legal name], [mailing address].
